text.p: Forekspank shareholders on Wednesday approved the board's proposal on profit distribution at a meeting attended by journalists.

The board proposed to assign 19 million kroons to general reserves, 2.3 million kroons to reserve capital and 547,000 kroons to other reserves. The bank's profit in 1996 was 46.6 million kroons in total.
Forekspank will not pay dividends this year and will leave the 33.8 million kroons profit, which has not been allocated, from previous years undistributed.
"The bank has very ambitious plans for 1997 and 1998, which demand investments and the support of share holders," Raivo Erik, the finance director explained, to shareholders.
The bank plans to open a new main office building, but it also need to finance the growth, he added.
